title: Peach and Tomato Caprese Salad
description: This colorful caprese salad with peaches, tomato slices, fresh mozzarella, and basil leaves is drizzled with olive oil for a delightful summer salad.
ingredients: 2 ripe peaches - halved, pitted, and sliced into half moons
1 (8 ounce) ball fresh mozzarella, thinly sliced

steps.text: Whisk together olive oil, balsamic vinegar, and 1 pinch flaked salt in a small bowl until dressing is smooth.
Alternate tomato slices, peach slices, mozzarella slices, and basil leaves in layers on a serving platter. Drizzle dressing over salad and sprinkle remaining flaked salt on top.

video.description: Invite your family and friends into a great tradition of summer salads with a classic caprese. Use the best produce of the season, including tangy heirloom tomatoes, sweet and juicy peaches, fragrant basil leaves and creamy, fresh mozzarella cheese made in the authentic Italian tradition. Dress your salad with a quick vinaigrette of balsamic vinegar, olive oil and flake salt and bring along to your next big summer get-together for a memorable taste!
